id: 537-第一次蒂卡爾-卡拉克穆爾戰爭
theater: 佩滕盆地蒂卡爾至卡拉克穆爾

battle.name: 第一次蒂卡爾-卡拉克穆爾戰爭
battle.theater: 佩滕盆地蒂卡爾至卡拉克穆爾
battle.brief: 公元537年，佩滕盆地的卡拉克穆爾聯同北方蛇族王室攻破蒂卡爾，焚燒其宮殿神廟，蒂卡爾舊王朝中斷，隨後陷入一百二十年的中世紀空白期。卡面那具羅馬扭力式投石機並未隨軍而至；瑪雅人靠投矛器、彈弓與火，扮演了巨砲在攻城裡的同一個角色。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 第一次蒂卡爾-卡拉克穆爾戰爭爆發於公元537年，是瑪雅古典期佩滕盆地最大的一次城邦對抗。交戰的兩方，一邊是蒂卡爾城邦及其領土內的從屬與盟友網絡，另一邊是聯結北方卡拉克穆爾蛇族王室的卡拉克穆爾城邦（古名烏克斯維察，意為三山）及其盟友。蒂卡爾在今瓜地馬拉東北部沼澤地，公元四世紀以來靠巨型台形建築群與長紀年碑銘主導中部瑪雅低地，把周邊城邦收為附庸；卡拉克穆爾在今貝里斯西部瓦卡高原上，離蒂卡爾約七十六公里，位於佩滕盆地南緣，兩城之間由納蘭霍這樣的中繼城邦相連。六世紀中葉，蒂卡爾在低地的權柄轉衰，納蘭霍脫離蒂卡爾而倒向卡拉克穆爾，後者隨即靠上北方的蛇族王室，取得足以對抗蒂卡爾的後盾。從編制上看，兩邊都不是常備軍國家，而是以城邦領袖為核心的徵召兵制：貴族與祭司集團隨王出行，平民戰士按村社分隊服役，武器自帶，糧食按戶供應。指揮系統極簡，通常只有一位統帥在前，勝負由城邦王室的宗族聯盟、盟城是否跟從，以及儀式程序是否完成來決定。
countriesEn: The First Tikal-Calakmul War broke out in AD 537 and was the largest confrontation between city-states in the Peten basin during the Classic period of the Maya. On one side stood Tikal and the network of subordinate and allied communities inside its territory; on the other stood Caracol, the city-state whose ancient name was Uxwitza, meaning Three Hills, together with its allies and with the Snake dynasty of Calakmul to the north. Tikal lay in the marshes of north-eastern present-day Guatemala and had led the central Maya lowlands since the fourth century through gigantic platform architecture and Long Count monuments, holding the surrounding towns as vassals. Caracol sat on the Vaca Plateau in what is now western Belize, some seventy-six kilometres from Tikal, on the southern rim of the Peten basin, with intermediary towns such as Naranjo linking the two. In the middle of the sixth century Tikal authority in the lowlands weakened, Naranjo slipped away from Tikal to Calakmul, and Caracol promptly attached itself to the Snake royal house in the north, gaining a patron strong enough to stand against Tikal. Neither side was a standing-army state. Both relied on a levy centred on the city ruler: nobles and priestly groups travelled with the king, commoner warriors were raised by village communities, each man brought his own weapons, and each household supplied his food. Command was minimal, normally a single war leader in the field, and the outcome was settled by the kinship alliances of the ruling houses, by whether allied towns followed, and by whether the ritual sequence that authorised the campaign had been carried out properly.
people: 留下姓名的當事人不多，留下碑銘的倒也不少。蒂卡爾方面，末代舊王朝之王「鳥爪」（Yax Ehb Xook，約公元527至537年在位）是關鍵人物：他的在位橫跨佩滕盆地權力結構的轉折門檻，公元537年他身後，蒂卡爾的舊王表就此中斷，核心區的立碑傳統也停了下來。卡拉克穆爾方面，公元531年即位的特卡布查克（Te' K'ab Chaak，即卡恩一世）站在戰爭的起點；其後接位的「水君」亞哈夫．特基尼奇二世（Yajaw Te' K'inich II，公元553年即位）在公元562年實施了第一次有文字記載的星戰，用金星的吉凶把一場征伐掛進宇宙秩序。公元562年，蒂卡爾的國王「雙鳥」（Wak Chan K'awiil）在星戰中敗陣，證明舊日的宗主已經反過來被附庸打倒。北方蛇族王室的介入者包括「捲蛇」烏內錢（Uneh Chan）一系，其後的塔佐姆．烏卡布卡克（公元622至630年在位）與大．尤克諾姆（公元636至686年在位）把蛇族的權勢推到頂峰，直到公元695年被蒂卡爾的「雙月」卡威爾二世打敗。現代學者方面，賓夕法尼亞大學蒂卡爾計畫的考古發掘、塔蒂阿娜．普羅庫里亞科娃對長紀年曆與王名的破譯，以及阿倫與黛安．蔡斯自1985年起主持的卡拉克穆爾考古計畫，是今日能讀懂這場戰爭的主要依靠；威廉．福蘭於1982至1994年間在卡拉克穆爾主持的發掘，則補上了戰爭前後城邦盛衰的物質證據。
peopleEn: Few of the actors left a name behind, but a good number left inscriptions. On the Tikal side the decisive figure was the last ruler of the Old Empire, Bird Claw, Yax Ehb Xook, in power from about AD 527 to 537: his reign straddled the threshold of the change in the balance of power in the Peten, and after his death in AD 537 the old royal line of Tikal was interrupted and the tradition of erecting monuments in the core stopped with it. On the Caracol side the war began under Te' K'ab Chaak, also known as K'an I, who took the throne in AD 531. His successor Yajaw Te' K'inich II, Lord Water, acceded in AD 553 and in AD 562 carried out the first star war recorded in writing, tying a campaign to the favourable aspect of Venus and so to the order of the cosmos. In that year of 562 Tikal's ruler Double Bird, Wak Chan K'awiil, was defeated in the star war, showing that the former overlord had been beaten by his own former vassal. On the northern side the Snake royal house entered through the line of Uneh Chan, the Scroll Serpent; Tajoom Uk'ab' K'ak', in power from AD 622 to 630, and Yuknoom the Great, from AD 636 to 686, brought the dynasty to its height, until Tikal's Double Moon, K'awil II, defeated them in AD 695. Among modern scholars, the University of Pennsylvania Tikal Project, Tatiana Proskouriakoff's decipherment of the Long Count and the royal names, and the Caracol Archaeological Project directed by Arlen and Diane Chase since 1985, are the main reasons this war can be read at all; William Folan's excavations at Caracol between 1982 and 1994 supplied the material evidence for the rise and fall of the two cities around the conflict.
kits: 卡面上的投石機並未隨軍進入佩滕盆地。卡面那具標示年代為公元前250年的羅馬扭力式投石機（onager），是希臘—羅馬世界用扭力索束把絞盤儲存的勢能換成一發石彈的攻城器械：底座上架起絞盤與配重臂，臂端繫住石彈或包鉛的彈丸，發射時靠索束回彈把石頭擲向城牆與塔樓，羅馬人在公元前二世紀之後把它列為攻城標配。公元六世紀的中美洲沒有任何這類機械，既無扭力砲也無配重巨砲，佩滕盆地的攻城靠別的東西。功能上與投石機最接近的，是投矛器（atlatl）與彈弓：投矛器把短矛再向前推一步，射程可達一百米上下，彈弓以羊毛編的帶子甩出石彈或陶彈，能把拋射物送到更遠的地方，兩者都是站定即能施放的投射火器。真正頂替巨砲破壞力的，是火。瑪雅人的建築以硬木為樀、以棕櫚與茅草覆頂，極易焚燒，公元537年蒂卡爾被攻破時燒掉的正是這類殿宇，後世因此把這類戰役稱為破壞之戰（hubi）。此外，佩滕盆地的出土物還留下整套古典期兵器：嵌黑曜石刃的macuahuitl木劍、長矛與矛鏃、投矛器與其鏃、彈弓與石彈、繃皮與木條製的矩形盾牌、棉絮甲與包布頭盔。古典期尚未出現弓箭，箭與弓要到後古典期才傳入中美洲，公元537年的人只能用投矛器與彈弓把投射物送出去；至於石彈、楔形石錘與壕溝障礙，也都是就地取材的臨時工事。
kitsEn: The catapult on the card never marched into the Peten basin. The machine shown, a Roman torsion onager dated on the card to 250 BC, is the siege engine of the Greek and Roman world that turned the potential stored in a winch into a single stone: a capstan and throwing arm mounted on a timber base, a sinew or rope skein providing the power, and a stone or lead-covered bolt slung at the arm, hurled at walls and towers. Rome carried it as standard siege equipment from the second century BC onward. There was nothing of the kind in sixth-century Mesoamerica, neither torsion artillery nor counterweight siege engines; the assault on Peten cities depended on other things entirely. The closest functional relatives of the onager were the atlatl and the sling. The atlatl extended the reach of a short spear by a further step, to a range of around one hundred metres, and the sling, a band of woven wool, could throw a stone or a fired clay ball even further; both were projectile weapons that could be used from a standing position. What actually replaced the destructive power of the great engine was fire. Maya buildings were framed in hardwood and roofed in thatch and palm, and burned readily, so the structures consumed when Tikal was taken in AD 537 were exactly such halls, and the campaigns that did this were thereafter called destruction wars, hubi. The Peten material record also preserves the full arms of the Classic period: the macuahuitl, a hardwood club with inset obsidian blades, spears and their points, atlatls and their points, slings and sling stones, rectangular shields of hide over wood, quilted cotton body armour and padded helmets. The bow and arrow were still unknown in the Classic period and reached Mesoamerica only in the Postclassic, so in AD 537 there was no way to put a projectile on a trajectory except with atlatl and sling; stones, wedge-shaped mauls and improvised ditches were all field works made from whatever the ground provided.
tactics: 瑪雅人沒有攻城塔，也沒有撞車。對付蒂卡爾那樣由台形建築群構成的要塞，常見的做法有三種：一是切斷城邦之間的白石堤道（sacbe），令蒂卡爾與卡拉克穆爾之間的陸路交通中斷，這在佩滕盆地的雨季尤其致命；二是以投矛器與彈弓從遠處向台基、屋脊與廣場傾瀉投射物，同時放火燒掉那些用硬木搭出高聳屋架的殿宇，逼守軍在煙與碎片之間失去指揮；三是逼近後沿石階攀上台頂，在狹窄的平台上展開近身格鬥。瑪雅人的近身武器是嵌黑曜石刃的macuahuitl木劍，配以長矛、投矛器與盾牌，防護則是棉絮甲與包布頭盔，頂盔用軟墊纏成，正好擋住從上方砸下的石彈。戰爭在銘文裡分為幾類：斧戰（ch'ak）是征服性戰爭，勝方要戴上被敗者的頭飾作為佔有；破壞之戰（hubi）是焚燒型襲擊；星戰則把戰爭掛上金星的吉凶，是最正式的一種。星戰之前有漫長的準備：貴族與祭司禁食、刺血放血、焚香，沿祖先的足跡舉行儀式，直至天象配合才出兵。糧食與飲水是決定性變數。圍城一方要餵養一支只帶數日口糧的軍隊，守方則靠城外的農地與蓄水塘撐下去；蒂卡爾在南側低地修築堤壩攔截薩爾瓦多河的水，正是為了在雨季保住城內的飲水，攻方則盡量縮短圍城時間，或趕在收穫季節之前撤走。
tacticsEn: The Maya had neither siege towers nor battering rams. Against a stronghold like Tikal, built of platform complexes, three methods were common. First, they cut the white limestone causeways, the sacbe, linking city to city, breaking overland movement between Tikal and Caracol, a matter of the first importance in the Peten rains. Second, they put missiles onto the terraces, roof ridges and plazas with atlatls and slings from long range while setting fire to halls whose high timber frames burned readily, denying the defenders command amid smoke and falling debris. Third, they came close, climbed the stone stairways onto the platform tops, and fought at close quarters in the narrow space up there. The close-combat weapon of the Maya was the macuahuitl, a hardwood club inset with obsidian blades, supported by spears, atlatls and shields; the defence was quilted cotton body armour and padded helmets, wound from soft stuffing, which turned aside stones falling from above. The inscriptions sort wars into types. The axe war, ch'ak, was a war of conquest whose victor took the headband of the defeated as a badge of possession. The destruction war, hubi, was a burning raid. The star war attached the campaign to the favourable aspect of Venus and was the most formal of all. Before a star war came a long preparation: nobles and priests fasted, drew blood and burned incense, and walked the paths of the ancestors in ceremony, and the campaign went out only when the sky agreed. Food and water were the decisive variables. A besieging host had to feed an army that carried only a few days of rations, while the defenders lasted on farmland and reservoirs outside the walls; the dikes Tikal built across the Rio Salvador on the southern lowland existed to keep the city's drinking water in the reservoirs through the wet season, and a besieging force would try to shorten the investment or withdraw before the harvest.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但有幾個屬於硬證據。距離：卡拉克穆爾至蒂卡爾約七十六公里，納蘭霍位於兩城之間，約各四十二公里。年代：戰爭起於公元537年，戰爭列表把它的下界定在公元572年，與瑪雅長紀年曆9.5.0.0.0（約公元532年）至9.7.0.0.0（約公元572年）這兩個卡頓世代大致吻合。關鍵一役定於公元562年，卡拉克穆爾的銘文把第一次星戰記在9.6.8.4.2。結果：蒂卡爾此後出現長達一百二十年的中世紀空白期（Middle Classic hiatus），大廣場一帶的紀念碑立造中斷，核心區人口下降；同一時期卡拉克穆爾的人口與大型建築同步增加，並修建通往納蘭霍的堤道系統。卡拉克穆爾最後一次有紀年的事件是10.1.10.0.0，即公元859年，其城邦範圍約二百平方公里。至於兵力、俘虜數與傷亡，銘文從不記數目，只記擒獲、焚燒與占領，所以任何精確的兵員數都是後人推估，不能當作事實。關於月份，現存銘文只把公元537年的事件定位在9.5世代之內，具體月令無從考定，本卡的月份欄按年初計，並非出於史料記載。
dataEn: There are not many checkable figures, but a few are hard evidence. Distances: Caracol to Tikal is about seventy-six kilometres, and Naranjo lies between the two at about forty-two kilometres from each. Dates: the war began in AD 537, and the war list sets its end at AD 572, which corresponds reasonably well to the two katun periods 9.5.0.0.0, about AD 532, and 9.7.0.0.0, about AD 572, of the Maya Long Count. The decisive engagement is dated AD 562, and the Caracol inscriptions place the first star war on 9.6.8.4.2. Outcome: Tikal then entered a hiatus of some one hundred and twenty years, the Middle Classic hiatus, with the erection of monuments in the Great Plaza interrupted and the population of the core declining; at the same time the population and monumental building of Caracol increased together, and the causeway system towards Naranjo was extended. The last dated event at Caracol is 10.1.10.0.0, AD 859, and the polity covered roughly two hundred square kilometres. As for troop numbers, captives and casualties, the inscriptions never give figures, only captures, burnings and the taking of sites, so any exact strength is a later estimate and must not be treated as fact. On the month: the surviving inscriptions place the events of AD 537 only within the 9.5 period, and the precise month cannot be established, so the month field of this card follows the start of the year and is not a claim from the sources.
cause: 打起來有幾層原因。最直接的一層是地位：卡拉克穆爾原本是蒂卡爾的附庸城邦，蒂卡爾靠著掌握低地核心的宗教與政治中心，維持對周邊小城的宗主地位；六世紀中葉蒂卡爾自身的統治出現裂痕，王位更替與人事斷層使納蘭霍等中繼城邦改投北方，附庸網絡開始鬆動。卡拉克穆爾要的就是這個機會：脫離蒂卡爾的宗主地位，取代它成為佩滕盆地的新中心。背後還有兩層更結構性的力量。一層是與北方蛇族王室的結盟：墨西哥卡拉克穆爾的Kaan（蛇）王室正把勢力伸進佩滕，卡拉克穆爾高階墓葬中更出現帶特奧蒂瓦卡納風格的火葬遺存，說明北方的影響早已先一步抵達。另一層是生態：古典期低地人口膨脹，燒荒與過度取水壓縮了可用農地，蒂卡爾一帶的彎曲河道只能靠堤壩與蓄水塘調節，兩座城邦都想把上游的水與下游的人口變成自己的資源。於是衝突從誰是宗主，變成誰能把對方從地圖上抹去。
causeEn: There were several layers of cause behind the fighting. The most immediate was status. Caracol had been a client state of Tikal, and Tikal maintained its overlordship over the smaller towns by controlling the religious and political centre of the lowlands. In the middle of the sixth century Tikal's own rule began to crack: a change of rulers and the loss of personnel at court allowed intermediary towns such as Naranjo to turn north, and the network of vassals began to come apart. Caracol wanted exactly that opening, to slip out from under Tikal and take its place as the new centre of the Peten basin. Behind that lie two more structural forces. The first is the alliance with the Snake royal house to the north: the Kaan, or Snake, dynasty of Calakmul in Mexico was reaching into the Peten, and a Teotihuacan-style cremation deposit in a high-status burial at Caracol shows that northern influence had already arrived ahead of the armies. The second is ecology. Population in the lowlands expanded during the Classic period, slash-and-burn clearing and over-drawing of water shrank the farmland that could be worked, and the meandering channels around Tikal could only be regulated by dikes and reservoirs. Both cities wanted the upstream water and the downstream people to become their own resources. In that way the contest shifted from the question of who was overlord to the question of who could erase the other from the map.
impact: 這一仗的後果，超出兩座城邦的勝負。對蒂卡爾而言，代價是整個舊帝國的終結：公元537年前後的城市核心遭到焚毀，宮殿與神廟的營建中斷，寫立紀念碑的傳統停擺，人口大量外流，蒂卡爾在佩滕盆地的核心位置被卡拉克穆爾接替。學者常以瑪雅低地的動盪來概括這段時期，認為古典期的城邦政治並非一路上升，而是在幾個世紀裡反覆崩解與重建。對卡拉克穆爾而言，這是一段黃金期：它的人口密度、紀念碑數量與堤道系統在六世紀末至七世紀達到頂峰，並把蒂卡爾式的建築風格與禮儀圖像反過來傳回佩滕東北，令蒂卡爾在復國之後的一段時間裡模仿卡拉克穆爾的造型，連宗主與附庸的關係也一度倒轉。對整個中部瑪雅低地而言，這場戰爭把權力重心推向盆地西部，也讓星戰這種把天文曆法與戰爭綁在一起的戰爭形式傳開，此後數百年裡一再出現，直到後古典期仍然作為正統性來源被引用。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached well beyond the fortunes of two cities. For Tikal the price was the end of an entire empire: the core of the city was burned around AD 537, the building of palaces and temples was interrupted, the tradition of erecting dated monuments stopped, population moved away in large numbers, and Tikal's position at the centre of the Peten basin passed to Caracol. Scholars often summarise this stretch of time as an upheaval of the Maya lowlands, arguing that Classic period city-state politics was not a steady rise but a repeated cycle of collapse and reconstruction. For Caracol it was a golden age: its population density, its number of monuments and its causeway system all peaked between the late sixth and the seventh century, and the architectural style and ritual imagery of Tikal travelled back the other way into the north-eastern Peten, so that for a time after its restoration Tikal imitated Caracol forms and even the relation of overlord and vassal was briefly inverted. For the central Maya lowlands as a whole the war pushed the centre of gravity westward across the basin and spread the star war, the form of warfare that tied campaigns to the astronomical calendar, which was used repeatedly for the next several centuries and remained a source of legitimacy as late as the Postclassic period.
result: 公元537年，聯結卡拉克穆爾的聯軍攻破並焚燒蒂卡爾，蒂卡爾的舊王朝中斷，佩滕盆地的權力中樞轉到卡拉克穆爾手裡，戰爭卻未就此收場。公元556年，蒂卡爾反過來打出一場斧戰，擊敗卡拉克穆爾；公元562年，卡拉克穆爾的水君發動第一次有紀錄的星戰，擊敗蒂卡爾的雙鳥，把舊宗主徹底壓下去，戰爭餘波延續到公元572年前後。此後蒂卡爾進入長達一百二十年的中世紀空白期，大廣場不再立碑，人口與營造活動委縮；卡拉克穆爾則迎來人口與大型營造的高峰，在七世紀初把勢力伸向納蘭霍，並於公元626、631與636年接連打敗納蘭霍。直到七世紀末蒂卡爾重現王表與匠人，公元695年更在雙月卡威爾二世治下打敗卡拉克穆爾，重新奪回中部瑪雅低地的霸主地位。對卡拉克穆爾自己而言，報復來得比蒂卡爾復國更晚：它最後的有紀年事件停在公元859年，城邦的廢墟一直留到公元1050年前後才完全無人居住，昔日的戰勝者最終走進同一片叢林。
resultEn: In AD 537 the coalition led by Caracol took and burned Tikal. The old dynasty of Tikal was interrupted and the centre of power in the Peten basin moved to Caracol, but the war did not stop there. In AD 556 Tikal fought back with an axe war and defeated Caracol; in AD 562 Lord Water of Caracol launched the first recorded star war, defeated Tikal's Double Bird and pressed the former overlord down completely, with the aftershocks running to around AD 572. Tikal then entered a hiatus of some one hundred and twenty years, erecting no more monuments in the Great Plaza while its population and building activity contracted. Caracol enjoyed a peak of population and large-scale construction, extending its reach towards Naranjo in the early seventh century and beating Naranjo in AD 626, 631 and 636. Only in the late seventh century did the royal line and the craftsmen reappear at Tikal, and in AD 695, under Double Moon K'awil II, Tikal defeated Caracol and took back the hegemony of the central Maya lowlands. For Caracol itself the reckoning came later than Tikal's restoration: its last dated event is AD 859, and the ruins of the city stayed inhabited only until around AD 1050, so the city that had once won ended up walking into the same forest.
